lesson.meaning: Able to wait calmly without getting annoyed or upset, even when things are slow or difficult.
examples: You need to be patient when learning a new software; it takes time to master.
Please be patient while our IT team resolves the network problem; it should be fixed soon.
The manager advised us to be patient with the new intern as she learns her responsibilities.
Dealing with customer complaints requires a patient and understanding approach.
Developing a successful business plan demands patient research and careful planning.
lesson.memory_tip: Mama says: Remember, 'patient' is about staying 'calm' even when you have to 'wait'. If you can 'wait with a smile', you are patient!
